com.gomtwigim.livemix.mic.Name: Microphone On/Off
com.gomtwigim.livemix.mic.Tooltip: Toggle a LiveMix microphone or explicitly set it on or off.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.all-mics.Name: All Microphones
com.gomtwigim.livemix.all-mics.Tooltip: Toggle all microphone switches, or turn them all on or off.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.mic-mute-group.Name: Microphone Mute Group
com.gomtwigim.livemix.mic-mute-group.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the microphones assigned to LiveMix's mute group.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.fx-mute-group.Name: FX Mute Group
com.gomtwigim.livemix.fx-mute-group.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the FX assigned to LiveMix's mute group.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.plugin-group.Name: Plugin Group
com.gomtwigim.livemix.plugin-group.Tooltip: Toggle an existing numbered plugin group on a microphone.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.fx-send.Name: FX Send Amount
com.gomtwigim.livemix.fx-send.Tooltip: Rotate to adjust the send amount; short press and release to toggle pre/post.

TriggerDescription.Push: Short press and release: toggle pre/post (when enabled).
TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust FX send amount; also while pressed.

com.gomtwigim.livemix.status.Name: Status
com.gomtwigim.livemix.status.Tooltip: Display connection, session or audio status. Press to refresh state.

Localization.tooltip: Toggle a LiveMix microphone or explicitly set it on or off.
Localization.fallback: Match the same name when changing sessions
Localization.offlineHelp: Start LiveMix and enable Settings → External control (Stream Deck).
Localization.disabledHelp: In LiveMix, enable Settings → External control (Stream Deck).
Localization.failure: The command failed. Check the connection and selected target.
Localization.allMicsTooltip: Toggle all microphone switches, or turn them all on or off.
Localization.micMuteGroupTooltip: Mute or unmute the microphones assigned to LiveMix's mute group.
Localization.fxMuteGroupTooltip: Mute or unmute the FX assigned to LiveMix's mute group.
Localization.pluginGroupTooltip: Toggle an existing numbered plugin group on a microphone.
Localization.fxSendTooltip: Rotate to adjust the send amount; short press and release to toggle pre/post.
Localization.statusTooltip: Display connection, session or audio status. Press to refresh state.
Localization.membershipNote: Assign members in LiveMix's mute groups.

Localization.rotateTrigger: Adjust FX send amount; also while pressed.
